newsitem.title: EU: EP Research Committee agenda - July 1-2.
newsitem.headline: EP Research Committee agenda - July 1-2.

text.p: Committee on Research, Technological Development and Energy [[ Tuesday 01 July 1997 ]]
===] Tuesday, 1 July 1997 at 3pm
===] In the presence of the Council and Commission
1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE 223.123 )
2. Approval of minutes of meetings of: - 14 & 16 April 1997, Brussels (PE 222.115 ) - 15 April 1997 (Hearing), Brussels (PE 222.116 ) - 12 May 1997, Strasbourg (PE 222.465 )
3. Chairman's announcements
4. Any other business

5. Monitoring report on specific research programme: Environment and Climate - Committee monitor: Giles CHICHESTER - Exchange of views with Mr Christian PATERMANN, Director, DG XII, European Commission

6. Environmental taxes and charges in the single market (T04481) (T04481) COS0542 COM(97)0009 C4-0179/97 + ENER Avis A HOLM Ulf. (V ) (PE222.955 ) F ENVI Fond R OLSSON Karl-Erik. (ELD) - First consideration of draft opinion - Deadline for tabling amendments

7. Budget 1998 - Section III (T05367) (T05367) BUD0083 + ENER Avis A McNALLY Eryl M. (PSE) (PE221.391/DEF) F BUDG Fond R TILLICH Stanislaw. (PPE) (PE222.006 ) - First consideration of draft opinion in the form of a letter

8. Access to the Japanese market (T04018) (T04018) COS0245 COM(95)0073 C4-0147/95 + ENER Avis A FORD James G. (PSE) (PE220.524/REV) F RELA Fond R MOORHOUSE James. (PPE) (PE220.136/A ) - Further consideration of draft opinion - Consideration of amendments

9. First action plan for innovation in Europe (Commission communication) (T04520) (T04520) COS0493 COM(96)0589 C4-0624/96 + ENER Fond R ROVSING Christian F. (PE222.460 ) (PPE) - First consideration of draft report - Deadline for tabling amendments

10. An EU action plan: satellite communications in the Information Society (T01590) (T01590) COS0453 COM(97)0091 C4-0131/97 + ENER Avis A MALERBA Franco E. (UPE) (PE222.956 ) F ECON Fond R HOPPENSTEDT Karsten (PPE) (PE222.598 ) - First consideration of draft opinion - Deadline for tabling amendments

11. The technological feasibility of trans-European hydraulic networks (T04594) (T04594) INI0450 INI0450 + ENER Fond R IZQUIERDO COLLADO J. (PE222.548/A ) (PSE) - First consideration of draft report - Deadline for tabling amendments
===] Coordinators' meeting (to be confirmed)
===] Wednesday, 2 July 1997 at 9am
12. Appointment of rapporteurs and draftsmen - decisions on procedure

13. Access to the Japanese market (T04018) COS0245 COM(95)0073 C4-0147/95 + ENER Avis A FORD James G. (PSE) (PE220.524/REV) F RELA Fond R MOORHOUSE James. (PPE) (PE220.136/A ) - Vote on and adoption of draft opinion
===] Joint discussion

14.1 Fifth EC framework research programme for research, technological development and demonstration activities (T05072) (T05072) COD97119 COM(97)0142 C4-0186/97 + ENER Fond R QUISTHOUDT-ROWOHL Go (PPE) (PE222.550 ) - Consideration of working documents

14.2 Fifth framework programme of the EAEC (Euratom) for research and training (1998-2000) (T05489) (T05489) CNS97120 COM(97)0142 C4-0234/97 + ENER Fond R QUISTHOUDT-ROWOHL Go (PPE) (PE222.962 ) - Consideration of working document

15. South Africa: concluding the Agreement for scientific and technological cooperation (T04572) (T04572) CNS97112 COM(97)0119 C4-0264/97 + ENER Fond R SCAPAGNINI Umberto. ( ) (PE222.954 ) - First consideration of draft report - Deadline for tabling amendments

16. Framework trade and cooperation agreement between the EC and the Republic of Korea (T03506) (T03506) CNS96098 COM(96)0141 C4-0073/97 + ENER Avis A POMPIDOU Alain. (UPE) (PE222.463 ) F RELA Fond R PORTO Manuel. (PPE) - First consideration of draft opinion - Deadline for tabling amendments
17. Joint Research Centre - Exchange of views with Professor Flemming WOLDBYE, Chairman, and members of the Board of Governors of the JRC
18. Date of next meeting - Tuesday, 15 July 1997 at 5.30pm (Strasbourg) - Wednesday, 3 September 1997 at 3pm and Thursday, 4 September 1997 at 9am (Brussels) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
